offering_description.value: Operates a chain of supermarkets selling groceries, fresh foods, and general merchandise to household consumers. Stores include pharmacies and fuel centers in many locations. Also sells private-label products.

primary_products.value: groceries; fresh produce, meat and deli items; dairy and frozen foods; private-label products; fuel

primary_services.value: pharmacy services; in-store bakery and deli prepared foods; online grocery pickup and delivery

customer_segment.value: B2C: household grocery shoppers and pharmacy customers

revenue_model.value: product sales: groceries, general merchandise and fuel sold at retail stores; healthcare reimbursement: prescriptions paid through insurers and pharmacy benefit plans

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys goods from food suppliers and distribution centers, sells to consumers in own stores

geography_served.value: US regional: Pennsylvania, Maryland, New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Virginia, West Virginia, Ohio

specialization.value: related lines: grocery supermarkets with pharmacy and fuel centers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated supermarkets and fuel stations; online: online ordering with pickup and delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety rules (FDA, USDA), pharmacy licensing and state boards, alcohol licensing, fuel regulations
